name: Gridlock Garden
label: Puzzle · 8×8 board
description: Cosy block-placement puzzle. Drag pastel garden tiles onto an 8×8 bed, fill rows and columns to make them bloom away, and chain combos for big scores. Has undo, hints, phone haptics and saves your best score. Made with Claude.

name: Apex Club
label: Racing · 3 laps
description: Top-down rally racer. Drive the orange car around Pinecrest Circuit and beat three computer drivers over three laps. Works with keyboard or touch, and saves your best lap. Made with ChatGPT Astra.

name: Wonderland Mini-Game
label: Party game · Team play
description: Party mini-game themed on Alice in Wonderland, played without looking at the character. Your team guides you to put the missing piece back. Built for a school group activity.

name: WordRush
label: Educational · 4 levels
description: Malay to English typing and translation game. Type the right translation as fast as you can, from beginner up to expert vocabulary.
